changed.item: 'I apologize for the wait in getting back to you' became 'sorry it took us so long to get back to you', which describes the delay as longer
'If you have any questions in the meantime' became 'If you have questions before then', which ties the window to when the battery ships rather than an open-ended interim period
'we will send you a replacement battery' became 'we're sending you a replacement battery', which makes the action sound already underway
